title: Verdict and Letter
author: L. M. Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
